parsed.explanation: Parent regime imposes traveler-facing tier-1 exposures: binary passport sex markers, visa refusal and possible fraud ineligibility on document discrepancy, exclusion from federal single-sex facilities, and documented abuse and care denial in national and immigration custody, only partly checked by courts. The state adds real mitigations—long-standing public-accommodations and hate-crime protections, X licence/birth-certificate options, shield listing and no documented local facility ban—but no enforcement outcomes for visitors are documented, and national border, airport and federal-building exposure follows the visitor regardless of state law. State protection therefore lifts the rating above the national mean without offsetting the shared parent regime.
